headline: S & M & N & S & Y climbs into ARC-2 gold with an 8.06-point gain

sections.text: S & M & N & S & Y climbed from 33rd to 15th on the ARC-2 public board, gaining 8.06 to reach 75.14 and move into the gold places.
The advance clears a rising cutoff: the last of the 17 gold places now requires 73.89, up 0.97 in the past day.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
